result.details:
Target reviewed: d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895. Assigned workspace /workspace/repo is baseline 5672ead2a526e07fea9ed11e58b3725e42013527, unmodified and clean. Detached disposable clone at /tmp/opencode/rev49/review, HEAD verified via git rev-parse HEAD.

FINDING (LOW): .github/workflows/release.yml:7-11 - triggers are `push: tags: [v*]` and `workflow_dispatch` only. This is the repository's sole workflow (find .github -type f), and its `Test`/`Static checks` steps sit inside the release job, gated on a tag already existing. Consequence: nothing runs bun test (263 tests), bun run check, build, package or package:verify on any branch or PR, so a regression can reach the tag and the first signal is a failing release job after the tag was pushed. tests/packaging.test.ts:1008 only asserts the release workflow's contents, not that a verification workflow exists. Recommendation: add a separate read-only workflow on pull_request/branch push running bun install --frozen-lockfile, bun test, bun run check with Bun pinned to 1.4.2, keeping it distinct so write permission stays with the draft job. Confidence high; code-evidenced (absent trigger, not runtime-reproducible).

VERIFIED NON-FINDINGS: (1) Per-test timeouts are explicit: Bun 1.4.2 default is 5000ms and a 6s test without a timeout fails at 5002ms, yet the slowest packaging tests measured 5.34-5.83s because they declare budgets (tests/packaging.test.ts:163 beforeAll 300000, :197 afterAll 60000 from target HEAD d428e0f, per-test 120000; tests/serve.test.ts:672/910 bound shutdown to 5000/15000ms). (2) Suite non-vacuous via the mutation probe above. (3) No state leakage; the packaging afterAll teardown works. (4) No vacuous assertions, no @ts-ignore/@ts-expect-error/@ts-nocheck, no `: any`/`as any`, no eslint-disable, one deliberate biome-ignore at tests/settings.test.ts:714, no TODO/FIXME/XXX/HACK anywhere in src, tests, scripts. (5) No real-provider reachability: only .example/.invalid/loopback literals in tests; src network I/O limited to src/providers/freestyle.ts:21 plus the ServerHandle.fetch interface; provider tests use tests/helpers.ts fakes. (6) Toolchain floor is declared and tested (engines.bun >=1.4.2, packageManager bun@1.4.2, tests/packaging.test.ts:844, workflow pins 1.4.2); Bun 1.3.14 exits 1 at install with UnknownLockfileVersion on lockfileVersion 2, which is the intended guard and the lockfile was never rewritten. (7) Coverage understates tested code (src/serve-command.ts 59.86%, src/cli/client.ts 51.11%, scripts/smoke.ts 10.89%) because the CLI/server run as compiled subprocesses in tests/packaging.test.ts.

LIMITATIONS: 4 full-suite runs (2 plain, --coverage, --reporter=junit) plus 4 single-file runs, not a 10x soak, so rare inter-test races are not excluded. Mutation probing covered one guard only. No bun run build/package/package:verify and no cloud, model-provider or real-infrastructure smoke. Static verification limited to the CI-configured tsc --noEmit and Biome recommended rules. Timings from this host, not GitHub ubuntu-24.04. Reviewer experiments live only outside /workspace/repo: /tmp/opencode/bun-linux-x64 (Bun 1.4.2), /tmp/opencode/rev49/review, /tmp/opencode/probe-tmo, /tmp/opencode/rev49/sanitize.ts (both artifacts passed through the target's production Redactor from src/security.ts; no credentials or credential-shaped examples included).

ARTIFACTS: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md (10 KiB) and /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/findings.json (6 KiB). Logs: /workspace/.swarmforge/logs/rev49-install.log, rev49-bun-test.log, rev49-bun-test-run2.log, rev49-check.log, rev49-coverage.log, rev49-junit.log, rev49-mutA.log.
